label: Thick dark material (Apple-style)
description: Modelled on Apple's thick/chrome materials: the sheet tints DARK rather than light, so it has no white floor. Worst-case composite over a bright photo is grey 89 (white text 6.9:1), and over dark media it reaches grey 9 — a far wider range than the light material's 33-94, which reads as more glass and less flat panel. Included so the sheet shows tint polarity as a visible option rather than an assertion: the arithmetic says scrim strength dominates, and this is the candidate that tests whether polarity buys anything on top.
